== IMG.01 DICOM/NIfTI volume construction ==
Intent: Read slices using spatial metadata and preserve original image artifacts 
Test: Round-trip known volume spacing/origin/orientation
 BOOK/LECTURE A05 ITK Software Guide | Volume 2 — Image reading/writing, filtering, registration, segmentation and analysis; find exact subchapter in chosen edition | https://itk.org/ITKSoftwareGuide/html/ | verified topical volume; exact chapter pending
 BOOK/LECTURE A16 DICOM Standard | Image spatial geometry, DICOM SEG and referenced source images; locate exact part/modules for version | https://www.dicomstandard.org/current | standard verified; section number pending
 BOOK/LECTURE A03 MIT HST.582J | Lecture 17 — Medical image modalities; Lectures 9,12 image processing | https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/hst-582j-biomedical-signal-and-image-processing-spring-2007/pages/lecture-notes/ | verified section
 PAPER P05 Breast MRI clinical trial image collections | https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/ispy2/
 REPOSITORY R06 SimpleITK | https://github.com/SimpleITK/SimpleITK 
  Inspect: Inspect ImageRegistrationMethod, Resample, direction/origin/spacing and examples 
  Reuse: Adopt supported registration/resampling and save transforms 
  Avoid: Do not assume registration always valid or comparability equal overlay 
  Verify: Known rigid transform, LPS/RAS roundtrip, failure QC
 REPOSITORY R07 IDC Index | https://github.com/ImagingDataCommons/idc-index 
  Inspect: Inspect IDCClient metadata hierarchy, SQL querying, download manifests 
  Reuse: Adopt maintained package to download authorized selected studies 
  Avoid: Do not bulk-download entire datasets or assume every cohort is in IDC 
  Verify: Download one approved series, SHA-256 and patient/study linkage
 REPOSITORY R13 Cornerstone3D | https://github.com/cornerstonejs/cornerstone3D 
  Inspect: Inspect packages/tools, viewport, segmentation loaders and examples 
  Reuse: Evaluate direct library integration rather than all of OHIF 
  Avoid: Do not recode entire DICOM viewport layer 
  Verify: Render known DICOM and overlay matched segmentation
 REPOSITORY R14 VTK | https://github.com/Kitware/VTK 
  Inspect: Inspect marching cubes, polydata and mesh export examples 
  Reuse: Adopt supported mesh extraction functions 
  Avoid: Do not infer anatomical truth from smoothing 
  Verify: Known-shape mask-to-mesh geometry test
